description: This file defines the LoginLog entity class for a human resource management system, mapping to the database table 'ohrm_login'. It includes properties for login details such as user ID, username, role, and login time, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LoginLog
classes.description: An entity class representing a login event, storing user identification and login timestamp information.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with this login log.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID for this login log.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username associated with this login log.

methods.name: setUserName
methods.description: Sets the username for this login log.

methods.name: getUserRoleName
methods.description: Returns the role name of the user.

methods.name: setUserRoleName
methods.description: Sets the role name of the user.

methods.name: getLoginTime
methods.description: Returns the login time as a DateTime object.
